plugins.description: Chat with Jarvis from Discord (your bot)
plugins.longevity_note: A bot token stays valid until you reset it in the Discord developer portal.

auth.instruction_md:
1. Open https://discord.com/developers/applications and click 'New Application'.
2. Go to the 'Bot' page, click 'Reset Token', and copy it (shown once).
3. Under 'Privileged Gateway Intents', enable 'Message Content Intent' so the bot can read message text.
4. Invite the bot to your server: OAuth2 -> URL Generator -> scope 'bot' + the permissions you want (View Channels, Read Message History, Send Messages), open the link, pick your server, Authorize.
5. Paste the bot token below, plus your numeric Discord user id (Developer Mode -> right-click yourself -> Copy User ID) so only you can command the bot.

plugins.post_install_hint_md: This enables the Discord channel — message your bot to talk to Jarvis. Outbound replies pass through the voice scrubber and your allowlist.

auth.instruction_md:

2. Send /newbot, pick a name and a username ending in 'bot'.
3. Copy the token BotFather gives you (looks like 123456789:AAH...).
4. Paste it below, then send /start to your new bot so it can reach you.

plugins.description: Search, read, create, share and delete your Drive files
plugins.longevity_note: Google expires the authorization after 7 days while your own OAuth app is in Testing mode. Publish the app to keep the connection indefinitely.
plugins.post_install_hint_md: Setup: see docs/marketplace/google-oauth-setup.md (shares the Google client with Gmail/Calendar). Talks to the Drive REST API v3 directly (Google's hosted Drive MCP is a Workspace-only Developer Preview that 403s consumer accounts). The full 'drive' scope grants read/write/delete over ALL your files and is a Google RESTRICTED scope: in 'Testing' status the refresh grant expires after 7 days, so publish the consent app to 'In production' and complete Google's restricted-scope (CASA) verification for uninterrupted offline access. A user, account, or administrator can still revoke the grant.

plugins.description: Play music, skip tracks and hear what is playing
plugins.longevity_note: Spotify caps a refresh token at six months, so the connection asks to be renewed twice a year. Nothing can extend that.
plugins.post_install_hint_md:
Setup: see docs/marketplace/spotify-oauth-setup.md. Spotify has no shared client — every install registers its own app, which takes about five minutes and needs no client secret. Register the redirect URI **exactly** as `http://127.0.0.1:3125/callback`; Spotify rejects `localhost`.

Controlling playback (play, pause, skip, volume) requires Spotify **Premium** — Spotify's own rule, not ours. Reading what is playing works on a free account. Spotify offers no revoke endpoint, so disconnecting here removes the local credential; remove the app itself under Account → Apps.

plugins.description: Play songs, albums and your playlists, pause, skip, like — and hear what is playing
plugins.longevity_note: Google expires the authorization after 7 days while your own OAuth app is in Testing mode. Publish the app to keep the connection indefinitely.
plugins.post_install_hint_md: Setup: see docs/marketplace/youtube-music-setup.md — it shares the Google OAuth client with Gmail, Drive and Calendar; only **enable the YouTube Data API v3** in that Cloud project, add the `youtube` scope, and list your own account under the app's **Test users** (or publish the app) — otherwise Google answers `403 access_denied`. Google publishes no YouTube Music API, so this talks to the official YouTube Data API v3 (search, your playlists, likes) and plays in a **background player** — a small window of its own that starts minimized, where you log in once for your Premium (Settings → Music can switch to the browser instead). Pause, skip, volume and "what is playing" steer that player; in browser mode they go through the system's media session (Windows out of the box; Linux needs `playerctl`, macOS `nowplaying-cli`). Google allows **100 searches a day** per project — enough for one household, not for a party.
